name: 45246 · Cincinnati, OH
findings: ZIP 45246 (Cincinnati) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45246 (Cincinnati) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45246 (Cincinnati) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
